text: At its meeting on December 2, 2021, the Nominating Panel – Committee of Adjustment considered Item NA10.1 - Agenda Item History - 2021.NA10.1 (toronto.ca) and made recommendations to City Council regarding candidates for appointment to the Committee of Adjustment.

City Council on December 15, 16, and 17, 2021, adopted the following: 1. City Council appoint the following two public members, one each to the North York and Scarborough panels of the Committee of Adjustment, for a term of office ending November 14, 2022, and until successors are appointed: Natasha Manning – North York Panel Igor Samardzic – Scarborough Panel 2. City Council direct that Confidential Attachments 1 to 6 to the report (November 16, 2021) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Committee of Adjustment.
